title: Achievement Unlock Log
dataSources: Life score (`lifeos:score`), quests / tasks (`quest:task`), habit streaks (`streak:status`), life achievements (`achievement:life`), household leaderboard (`household:leaderboard`), plus every other `index=personal` sourcetype as input.
app: The parody-the-enterprise meta layer — a Personal NOC (house-health wall), Personal SOC (entry / impossible-travel), Personal SRE (SLOs on your own habits), and a gamification layer (XP, achievements, streaks, household leaderboards) — all computed in Splunk over `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=achievement:life
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as unlocked, values(achievement) as badges by _time
| sort - _time
description: Logs the achievements and badges you unlock each month — first 10k, dry January, read 12 books.
value: Celebrating unlocked milestones, however small, keeps the momentum of self-improvement going.
implementation: Ingest achievement unlocks into `index=personal`; summarise per month.
visualization: Table of achievements unlocked by month.
grandmaExplanation: It keeps a log of the milestones you unlock, so you can celebrate every win big or small.
